parameters.jsCode:
const primaryLeads = $('Count Websites & Normalize                                                                                                                  ').first().json.normalizedLeads;                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                  
const data = $input.first().json.data;                                                                                                                              
const raw = Array.isArray(data[0]) ? data[0] : data;                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                
const fallbackLeads = raw.map(lead => ({
businessName: lead.name || null,
websiteUrl: lead.website || null,
location: lead.address || null,                                                                                                                                   
phoneNumber: lead.phone || null,
email: null,                                                                                                                                                      
source: 'outscraper'                                                                                                                                            
}));

return [...primaryLeads, ...fallbackLeads].map(lead => ({ json: lead }));
